seo.title: Isôoko Community Development — Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko n'Abagore i Masoro, Rwanda
seo.description: Isôoko Community Development (ICD) iteza imbere urubyiruko n'abagore i Masoro, mu Rwanda, binyuze mu burezi, ubuzima, ubucuruzi, siporo n'ubuziranutse.

hero.title: Guteza Imbere Abaturage ba Masoro
hero.subtitle: Guteza Imbere Abagore · Guteza Imbere Urubyiruko · Siporo n'Ubuziranutse · Ikoranabuhanga n'Uburezi

mission.title: Intego Yacu
mission.body: Duhinga iterambere ryuzuye n'amahirwe ku bagore n'urubyiruko binyuze mu buzima n'ubuziranutse, burezi n'ubucuruzi. Ikigo cyacu cy'abaturage mu Karere ka Masoro gifite ibikoresho bya siporo, laboratwari ya mudasobwa, isomero n'ibiro bishyigikira ibikorwa byinshi by'uburezi n'ubutunzi.

programs.title: Porogaramu Zacu
programs.subtitle: Porogaramu eshanu zifatanije zifite ingaruka ziramba ku baturage

cta.title: Twunganire mu Guteza Imbere Masoro
cta.text: Inkunga yawe ifasha abagore gukora ubucuruzi, urubyiruko kuronka ubumenyi, n'imiryango gutera imbere.
